name: @pipeworx/mcp-greenhouse

tools.name: greenhouse_list_candidates
tools.description: Search candidates in your ATS. Returns names, IDs, email addresses, and application status. Use greenhouse_get_candidate for full profile details.

tools.name: greenhouse_get_candidate
tools.description: Get full candidate profile by ID. Returns resume, contact info, application history, interviews, and notes.

tools.name: greenhouse_list_jobs
tools.description: Browse open and closed job postings. Returns titles, IDs, departments, statuses, and posting dates. Use greenhouse_get_job for full details and candidate pipeline.

status.description: Filter by status: open, closed, draft (optional)

tools.name: greenhouse_get_job
tools.description: Get complete job details by ID. Returns description, requirements, hiring team, and linked applications.

tools.name: greenhouse_list_applications
tools.description: View job applications across your pipeline. Returns applicant names, job IDs, application status, and submission dates. Filter by job or stage (e.g., 'screening', 'interview').

status.description: Filter by status: active, converted, hired, rejected (optional)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-greenhouse forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the greenhouse pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
